senses.gloss: a priestly division, named after its head.
poetic name of Sepphoris in Galilee whither the division of J. was exiled (v. Y. l. c.).
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:11:1">Koh. R. to VII, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:3">IX, 10</cite> <he>בני י׳</he> sons of J. (inhabitants of Sepph.).
